Question ID: ENG3_U04_PRE_Q01

MLA Standard: MLA.ENG3.RS.01

Passage: A deserted library still has names written on the checkout cards. Source note: Libraries in literature can represent shared memory and public learning. Which research question best fits the source set?

answer.text: A. What color are the checkout cards?

feedback.text: This is too narrow and not interpretive. Recheck the passage, context, or task wording and choose the option that preserves meaning and matches the standard.

answer.text: B. How do the checkout cards help develop the idea of shared public memory?

feedback.text: Correct. This is an interpretive research question supported by both sources. Notice how the answer uses the exact wording, evidence, or concept required by the standard.

answer.text: C. Who designed the library building?

feedback.text: This asks for outside factual information not supplied. Recheck the passage, context, or task wording and choose the option that preserves meaning and matches the standard.

answer.text: D. Are libraries better than schools?

feedback.text: This adds an unsupported comparison. Recheck the passage, context, or task wording and choose the option that preserves meaning and matches the standard.
